_comment: Single source for the default models. ai-provider.ts imports it and scripts/check-ai.mjs reads it, so the diagnostic can never report on a model the app does not use. Every provider here has a free tier, and one with no key is skipped - so adding a key is all it takes to widen the chain. `order` is the order they are tried in: the most capable and least saturated free tier first. Override a model per environment with GEMINI_MODEL / GROQ_MODEL / MISTRAL_MODEL / OPENROUTER_MODEL.
_comment_openrouter: Measured 2026-10-23 with a Spanish tool-calling probe. nemotron-3-super, the previous primary, answered 404 - gone - so every turn that reached OpenRouter was losing an attempt. nemotron-3-ultra (550B) called the tool with complete arguments in 2.9-3.7 s, but came back empty at 400 tokens because it spent them reasoning; with reasoning effort low (ai-provider.ts sends it) it used ~135. dots-3-note-preview: complete, 2.3-2.7 s (the plain dots-3 mangled tool names on 2026-10-08; this variant did not). nemotron-3.5-lightning: 1.6-1.9 s, once dropped an argument. Gemma 4 and xing4.0 were 429, inkling answers 403 outside agentic harnesses. OpenRouter accepts at most three models per request and falls through the list on 404 and 429 (measured) - but NOT on 402. Two models from one vendor tend to saturate together, which is why dots sits between the two NVIDIA ones.
_comment_unverified: gemini and mistral could not be measured: no key existed when they were added. gemini-flash-latest is Google's alias for the current Flash, the family its free tier covers; mistral-small-latest is the model its free tier is most consistently reported to include. Confirm both with `npm run check:ai` once their keys are set.
_comment_paid: Every model here is free on purpose. To move to a paid one - x-ai/grok-4.7 is the intended upgrade, USD 1.60/M in and 4.80/M out - the OpenRouter account must have purchased credits first. TRAP, measured on 2026-09-28: an account with no credits answers 402, and a 402 does NOT fall through to the rest of the models array - the whole request fails, taking the free models down with it.
